name: Light Of The Ancients
description:
About This Game

Deep within the archaic halls of a forgotten temple lies the secret to restoring a lost world. Guided only by ancient mechanisms, you'll journey through a crumbling ruin where nature, technology, and myth intertwine.

Light of the Ancients is a calm, first-person puzzle adventure focused on environmental storytelling and laser-based challenges. Each puzzle is a self-contained door to the next — simple in concept, satisfying in execution. You'll manipulate beams of light, reflect them through mysterious devices, and unlock ancient pathways as you move deeper into the temple's heart.

This is a short, single-player experience designed to be approachable and immersive, ideal for players who enjoy quiet, thoughtful gameplay without pressure or combat. The temple holds its secrets — it's up to you to bring its story back into the light!
short_desc: Light of the Ancients is a relaxing first-person puzzle game where you solve environmental challenges to unlock ancient pathways and uncover a long-lost secret.
